scope: Transport-only verification: real Node MessageChannels and one Node Worker, with deliberately simulated TrustedStorageSession methods. No Rust persistence, native WebView isolation or desktop parity is established.

immutableInstall.peerWarnings: Existing monorepo peer warnings remain visible in install output; no new tauri-bridge missing peer is reported.

coverage: All 256 byte values and retained input/cache buffers, including Buffer subclasses.
Exact request schemas, forbidden owner/handle/path/window fields, reused IDs, unexpected ports and safe errors.
Cancellation/timeout/disposal settlement, close idempotency and close-error visibility to the trusted caller.
Host operation/backing-buffer limits, retained cancellation accounting and capacity recovery after settlement.
The unchanged client executes in a real Node Worker; trusted host explicitly disposes authority after Worker termination.
limitations: Every session method is simulated. No native command or Rust binding is present.
Node Worker absence of Tauri globals does not prove native-browser privilege isolation.
Message queue/deserialization, aggregate owners/ports, read/response memory and native resource accounting are not fully bounded.
No snapshot/event streams, full nbstore API, editor storage switch, large-document compatibility, cloud or migration acceptance.
The new three-platform transport CI is configured but has not yet supplied native runner results for this source.
